triage.proposed_comment: Fixed by PR #12657 (merged 2024-05-24) via commits `1c9186fa` and `d14aaaf2`: the season chooser now calls `season_chooser()` which marks irrelevant seasons as `disabled`, and the template renders those as unlinked, greyed-out `<div class='disabled'>` entries rather than clickable links.

verify.final_comment: Fixed by commits 1c9186fa (2024-05-08) and d14aaaf2 (2024-05-09): the season chooser now calls season_chooser() in view.py which marks seasons as disabled when they are not in legal_seasons, and the template renders those as unlinked <div class='disabled'> entries rather than clickable links. The card view (card.py) sets legal_seasons to only seasons where the card was legal. Note: these commits were not part of PR #12657; that PR (commit e33bb00) only improved chooser spacing.
